facts.statement: The Free Realms team posted a Thanksgiving greeting to players in the United States of America (Unión Americana).
facts.quote: El equipo de Free Realms les desea a todos nuestros jugadores en la Unión Americana un feliz y saludable día de Acción de Gracias.

facts.statement: The Free Realms team posted a Thanksgiving greeting in Spanish to its players in the Americas (as worded: 'Unión Americana').
facts.quote: El equipo de Free Realms les desea a todos nuestros jugadores en la Unión Americana un feliz y saludable día de Acción de Gracias.

facts.statement: The Free Realms team posted a Thanksgiving greeting to players in the U.S. and elsewhere.
facts.quote: Everyone on the Free Realms team would like to wish our players in the U.S. and elsewhere a happy and healthy Thanksgiving.

article_summaries.title: ¡Feliz dia de Accion de Gracias!
article_summaries.summary: A short Spanish-language SOE holiday greeting from the Free Realms team to players in the United States, wishing them a happy and healthy Thanksgiving. It contains no game mechanics, quests, items, prices, events or other gameplay details. Its only game-related content is that it was posted to the official site, in the Free Realms news section.

article_summaries.title: ¡Feliz dia de Accion de Gracias! (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: This is a short Spanish-language Thanksgiving greeting posted on the official Free Realms news page. The team wishes players in the 'Unión Americana' a happy Thanksgiving. It contains no game mechanics, items, quests, prices or event details.

article_summaries.title: Happy Thanksgiving!
article_summaries.summary: A short official freerealms.com news post from the Free Realms team wishing players in the U.S. and elsewhere a happy and healthy Thanksgiving. It contains no game mechanics, items, events or numbers. The page is titled 'Free Realms - What is New?' and the post is listed under that news section.
